name: cronjob_job_stuck_running
row_template: *ClusterName:* {k8s_cluster} | Namespace: {namespace} | CronJob: {cronjob} | Job stuck running for >2h
description: Warning: CronJob has an active job running for more than 2 hours. The job may be stuck or hanging. Check pod logs and consider setting activeDeadlineSeconds on the job spec to auto-terminate long-running jobs.
